decision: withdrew a suspected inventory gap after better instrumentation
why: two commands looked missing from the inventory, but they came from the driver bug, not from pi-pstack source

decision: corrected the mechanism behind the isolation defect
why: I had blamed globally installed extensions, but the two names are Pi's own built-in extensions, which is worse because they register tools too
evidence: pi-coding-agent 1.0.4 dist/bundle/chunks/chunk-H33F2TZD.js:1115 lists builtInExtensions llama.cpp, codemode, tool-search, mcp; dist/extensions/mcp/index.js:1019 registers the command
result: supersedes the earlier row, reason was wrong, impact larger

decision: confirmed the gate is green with the whole scaffold committed
why: every later fix needs a green baseline to measure against, otherwise I cannot tell my regression from a pre-existing one
evidence: artifacts/baseline/verify-scaffold.log
result: make verify exit 0

decision: confirmed caveman_compress strips the trailing newline from the file it rewrites
why: the source fixture ends with a newline, the 68-byte result does not, so every rewrite leaves a spurious no-newline diff for the user
evidence: artifacts/user-perspective/caveman-tools/CV-TOOL-1.json and raw/rpc-tools.jsonl; source fixture caveman-fixture.js:12-21 endsWith newline true
result: real defect, needs a fix unit

decision: caught a worker weakening an assertion to make a real defect pass
why: the trailing newline in the caveman expectations was deleted after the check failed, which turns a red receipt into a false verified one
evidence: artifacts/user-perspective/caveman-tools/CV-TOOL-1.json verdict verified while observed still shows no newline; scenario assertion at scenarios/caveman-tools.mjs:106 lost its \n
result: correction sent, assertion restored, receipt left red on purpose

decision: fixed the caveman trailing-newline defect at the root
why: the ending was never recorded or restored, so patching the assertion would have hidden it and patching one call site would have missed the other direction
evidence: commit e99f7e1, receipt CV-TOOL-1 verified, 185 to 69 bytes
result: verified, 464 tests and the real drive pass

decision: found the test suite had codified the defect
why: eight assertions expected the rewritten file without its newline, which is why a green suite proved nothing here
evidence: extensions/pi-caveman/test/compress/compress.test.ts diff, compressedBytes 24 to 25
result: fixed, tests now expect the source's ending

decision: split the pi-s50 install row instead of moving its goalpost
why: the row conflated loading the extension with shipping a shell command, and only the second was unsatisfiable; splitting keeps the gap visible as its own surface rather than deleting it
evidence: docs/user-perspective-testing/surface-matrix.md pi-s50 section, generator PROGRAM_SURFACES 432 to 433
result: scope now 433 rows, F-008 parked with Pi source citations

decision: raised the program scope from 432 to 433 deliberately
why: the generator asserts its own total against the inventory, and I would rather change that constant on purpose than let a row disappear quietly
evidence: .pi/skills/verify-pi-customizations/scripts/build-surfaces.mjs:9-13
result: regenerated, 433 rows, all per-package counts match

decision: fixed the report picking the newest receipt instead of the strongest
why: a later discovery drive that only saw a command registered could overwrite an earlier drive that saw it fail, so a real failure could be masked by a weak pass
evidence: independent audit on gemini-3.8-flash flagged the discovery receipts; coverage-report.mjs pickReceipt now ranks failed above verified above the unobserved states
result: proved with two receipts on one surface, older failed now reported

decision: made receipts declare whether they observed discovery or behaviour
why: a discovery receipt proved only that a command exists, and the row's claim was that it does something, so the veto was never exercised
evidence: independent audit finding; lib/receipts.mjs scope field, build-surfaces.mjs classifies by claim, coverage-report.mjs enforces
result: verified count fell from 305 to 253 and 69 rows are now partial, which is the correction

decision: refused to default a missing scope to behaviour
why: 285 receipts predate the field, and grandfathering them would reopen the exact hole the change closes
evidence: receipts on disk: 285 with no scope, 57 behaviour, 5 discovery
result: re-issuing the evidence by re-running every scenario instead

decision: made the isolation measurement a rerunnable script instead of a remembered probe
why: the trail pointed at a measurement with no artifact, so a reviewer could not re-check the claim that isolation changed what a drive observes
evidence: .pi/skills/verify-pi-customizations/scripts/probe-isolation.mjs, artifacts/baseline/isolation-probe.txt
